''See also: [[Omega Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Omega is an [[assassin]] for hire, also known as the [[Grave Hound]], who operates under a set of personal principles despite his chaotic and unpredictable nature. He possesses a highly versatile physiology, capable of shifting between a human appearance—typically resembling a man in his forties with dark hair, a trimmed beard, and an orange [[Aethertech]] replacement eye—and a dark, shapeshifting biomass or ooze. This organic form allows him to sprout multiple eyes or mouths, manifest faces from gray matter, and flow through ship wreckage. He can regenerate his physical structure by consuming organic matter via mass [[fabricators]]. Though he is a dangerous individual who claims to be willing to kill for any reason, he has been known to protect the powerless under specific conditions. He is a contract worker who maintains professional ties to employers and has been involved with various enterprises, including a private detective agency. Omega is capable of enduring [[Subspace]] longer than standard humans and has demonstrated a willingness to face extreme danger, such as being strapped to a powerful [[neutron missile]]. He is often viewed as an annoying but unavoidable distraction by those around him.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Omega can manifest a human form appearing as a forty-year-old man with dark hair, a short beard, and orange eyes. His body is partially composed of dark gray or black ooze that can sprout mouths, eyes on stalks, and tendrils. He features [[Aethertech]] modifications fused with his flesh, including a prosthetic left eye embedded in a metal frame that blazes orange.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|A famous [[assassin]] and mercenary known as the [[Grave Hound]], Omega is described as a chaotic yet rational crew member. He is motivated by a desire to defeat [[Solstice]], whom he blames for the loss of his family and reputation. He views certain individuals as fun challenges to unravel and possesses a dark sense of humor regarding his own potential demise.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Omega is the father of [[Aila Escalon]] and the grandfather of Jak. He has fought his daughter, [[Aila Escalon|Aila]], and is also connected to a clone of her. Omega views [[Raion Raithe|Raion]] as a fun challenge for unraveling his persona, and he has completed assignments for [[Benri Vallenar]]. Additionally, Omega previously attacked [[Varic Vallenar]] at the [[Magic Tower]] and has been targeted by [[Sola Kalter|Sola]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Omega can dissolve his body into a gray mass to slither through walls or move through [[Subspace]] at will. He utilizes an internal [[Subspace Drive]] and inventory to store mass for regeneration or to hold weapons like his [[enchantment-breaking gun]]. Additionally, he can devour others to drag them through [[Subspace]] and manifest multiple hands or eyes from his biomass.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|The Grave Hound}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|Known as the [[Grave Hound]], Omega is an [[assassin]] who can dissolve his body into a gray mass to move through [[Subspace]].<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c10">''The Captain'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c15">''The Captain'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c26">''The Captain'', chapter 26</ref> In his human form, he appears as a forty-year-old man with dark hair and a short beard.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c10" /><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c12">''The Captain'', chapter 12</ref> His [[Aethertech body]] features a prosthetic left eye that blazes orange and is embedded into a patch of [[steel]].<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c10" /><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c12" /><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c15" /> Omega possesses an internal [[Subspace Drive]] that allows him to pop in and out of [[Subspace]] at will.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c15" /><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c23">''The Captain'', chapter 23</ref> He can regenerate from gray ooze by using [[Subspace]] to store a limited stockpile of excess matter.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c12" /><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c15" /><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c23" /> A potential entity responsible for distracting [[Magic Tower security]], this at least hundred and fifty-year-old attacker uses a gun to fire energy-trailing bullets capable of piercing normal starship armor.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c23" /><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c24">''The Captain'', chapter 24</ref><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c26" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|Prisoner and escapee}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|Initially kept in confinement, Omega was a character responsible for spreading information regarding the [[Captain of The Last Horizon]].<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c26" /><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c27">''The Captain'', chapter 27</ref> This prisoner managed to escape the ship's prison by utilizing a colorless copy of himself, though they were eventually relocated to a new holding facility.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c29">''The Captain'', chapter 29</ref><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c35">''The Captain'', chapter 35</ref> Known by the names [[Omal]] or [[Grave Hound]], this famous galactic [[assassin]] is renowned for sabotage and would be willing to attack a [[Hive]] for one hundred thousand standards.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c40">''The Captain'', chapter 40</ref> While possessing the ability to take human form and chuckle in three different voices simultaneously, Omega's ultimate goal is to pursue [[Solstice]].<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c41">''The Captain'', chapter 41</ref><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c46">''The Captain'', chapter 46</ref> During an encounter where they hid in the shadows, Omega attempted to shoot the narrator but was unable to pull a trigger.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c41" /><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c47">''The Captain'', chapter 47</ref> After being shot by [[Sola Kalter|Sola]], Omega's body transformed into gray goo, and they were later seen using an orange-flashing [[enchantment-breaking gun]].<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c41" /><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c48">''The Captain'', chapter 48</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Crew member on Horizon}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|As a crew member on the [[Horizon]], Omega communicates through a [[Subline]] connection and utilizes a unique form of [[Subspace warp]] for travel.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c3">''The Knight'', chapter 3</ref> This experienced man, who possesses at least a century of experience and rare [[Aethertech]], uses specialized eyes and guns that he stores within a [[Subspace inventory]].<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c3" /><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c36">''The Knight'', chapter 36</ref> His body is partially composed of a dark gray ooze that can reform, allowing him to partially liquefy himself, slither away, or sprout eyes from fifteen dark gray tendrils.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c4">''The Knight'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c8">''The Knight'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c22">''The Knight'', chapter 22</ref> While he can keep the [[Horizon]] company by dancing onto the bridge, Omega also operates and links himself to the [[Pilot]] [[console]].<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c14">''The Knight'', chapter 14</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c18">''The Knight'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c23">''The Knight'', chapter 23</ref> Known by the real name [[Omal]], he was once seen sitting at an orange-lit wedge of a table and later appeared on the ship's [[console]] surrounded by bodies.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c8" /><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c18" /><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c23" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Away team mission}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|As a member of an away team deployed onto enemy vessels, Omega serves the crew by operating scanners and the [[Subspace Drive]].<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c37">''The Knight'', chapter 37</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c38">''The Knight'', chapter 38</ref> During his mission, he suffered partial [[destruction]] that left only the top-right quarter of his body intact.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c37" /> Despite this damage, he demonstrated the ability to evade enemy fire and debris while navigating a shifting gap within a worm's body.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c39">''The Knight'', chapter 39</ref> Omega, who chuckles using half a dozen different voices, wears the orange-and-white combat suit of the [[Titan Knights]].<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c39" /><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c42">''The Knight'', chapter 42</ref> He refers to the narrator as Captain and was the final individual saved by the narrator.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c40">''The Knight'', chapter 40</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c42" />}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">8</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|[[Omega]] was partially destroyed, with only the top-right quarter of his body remaining intact.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c37" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|[[Omega]] is a crew member who operates scanners and the [[Subspace Drive]].<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c38" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|[[Omega]] chuckles in a half-dozen different voices.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c39" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|[[Omega]] is capable of evading debris and enemy fire while moving through a changing gap in a worm's body.<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c39" />}}</li>

{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|As a combatant, Omega utilizes an [[optical implant]] to receive various feeds.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c3">''The Pilot'', chapter 3</ref> He was observed standing over a bloody corpse.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c3" /> His physiology includes a mouth that forms upon a tendril extending from his shoulder.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c4">''The Pilot'', chapter 4</ref> While spinning a handgun, he can be seen chewing gum.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c4" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Vault prisoner}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Omega is an entity kept within a secure [[vault]] that possesses the ability to manifest as black ooze.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c8">''The Pilot'', chapter 8</ref> He can use this dark goo to hold himself together in a human form, though he also possesses regenerative capabilities.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c8" /><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c14">''The Pilot'', chapter 14</ref> As the father of [[Aila Escalon]], this being serves as a device or entity used for sensors while located inside the [[Shadow Ark]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c14" /><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c16">''The Pilot'', chapter 16</ref> Although he is not aboard the ship, Omega can pool on the ceiling of the [[Divine Titan]]'s cockpit and manifest his upper body by oozing across surfaces.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c15">''The Pilot'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c18">''The Pilot'', chapter 18</ref> His physical form is quite unusual, as he can sprout new mouths, including one on the side of his neck, and even manifest a tongue from his finger.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c15" /><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c18" /><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c24">''The Pilot'', chapter 24</ref> Furthermore, he is capable of keeping most of his mass tucked away in [[Subspace]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c24" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Shadow Ark}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Omega is a starship operator who has taken control of the cargo ship.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c25">''The Pilot'', chapter 25</ref> An admitted [[assassin]] for hire, this pilot speaks in several voices at once and possesses eyes on stalks.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c26">''The Pilot'', chapter 26</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c28">''The Pilot'', chapter 28</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c29">''The Pilot'', chapter 29</ref> Capable of resisting the call of [[Subspace]] longer than a normal human, Omega can manifest multiple pairs of hands.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c29" /> The [[World Spirit]] helped the [[Pilot]] escape an encirclement by the defenders of Fathom, though he has also fought his own daughter.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c30">''The Pilot'', chapter 30</ref> This insane killer can reconstitute himself after being shot, bleeds black goo from his knuckles, and can pull a glowing orange gun from [[Subspace]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c30" /> After fighting [[Aila Escalon|Aila]] and the [[Zenith Blade]], Omega demonstrated the ability to fold himself into darkness to disappear into [[Subspace]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c30" /> Having completed discreet assignments for [[Benri Vallenar]], Omega spoke about [[Solstice]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c32">''The Pilot'', chapter 32</ref> Known as the [[Grave Hound]] and the founder of Escalon, Omega serves as a valuable source of information against the enemy.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c34">''The Pilot'', chapter 34</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c35">''The Pilot'', chapter 35</ref> He can melt into goo to flow through wall channels for escape, though his supply of mass responds sluggishly when low.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c36">''The Pilot'', chapter 36</ref> Omega once infiltrated Benri Vallenar{{!}}Benri's peers by disguising himself as an underling.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c38">''The Pilot'', chapter 38</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Crew of The Last Horizon}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|As a provisional crew member, Omega utilizes [[Aethertech]] in his ears and serves as the helm while acting as a passenger on the shuttle.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c40" /><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c41">''The Pilot'', chapter 41</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c42">''The Pilot'', chapter 42</ref> The grandfather of Jak, Omega possesses a metallic eye capable of expansion.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c42" /> He is the father of [[Aila Escalon]], a person he has fought, and he currently possesses a clone of his daughter.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c44">''The Pilot'', chapter 44</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c46">''The Pilot'', chapter 46</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c47">''The Pilot'', chapter 47</ref> Serving as the [[Pilot]], Omega can enhance the thrusters of [[The Last Horizon]] or dissolve his form into black goo.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c47" /> He is capable of wrapping himself in a missile to destroy an [[Iron Hive]] before pulling himself back together.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c48">''The Pilot'', chapter 48</ref> Omega, who once remarked that a stronger contract eats a weaker one, would find it hilarious to die for the ruin of his own home planet.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c48" /> Ultimately, Omega was gone.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c49">''The Pilot'', chapter 49</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">14</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">

<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Omega]] is a passenger on the shuttle and acts as the helm.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c42" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Omega]] is [[Jak's grandfather]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c42" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Omega]] has a metallic eye that can expand.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c42" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Omega]] is someone [[Aila Escalon]] has fought.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c44" />}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Omega]] can enhance the thrusters of [[The Last Horizon]] as the [[Pilot]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c47" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Omega]] can dissolve into black goo.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c47" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Omega]] can wrap himself in a missile to blow up an [[Iron Hive]] and pull himself back together.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c48" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Omega]] is a character who would find it hilarious if he died for the ruin of his own home planet.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c48" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Omega]] previously stated that a stronger contract eats a weaker contract.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c48" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|[[Omega]] was gone.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c49" />}}</li>
</ul></div>
